title.zh: 所得税（经济与技术发展贷款利息及其他付款豁免）（第 7 号）公告 2014
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 7) Notification 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 7) Notification 2014.
(2) Paragraph 2 shall be deemed to have come into operation on 7th May 2012.
(3) Paragraph 3 shall be deemed to have come into operation on 19th June 2012.
